title: Team building
summary: The gaffer's idea of team building: a day in the woods building rafts. Your raft is going to sink, and the gaffer is on it. A season on, he's booked the woods again.

ends.title: The raft
ends.text: On the gaffer's team-building day your raft sank with him on it. The photo is in his office. He says it was the best day of the season.

ends.title: Dry land
ends.text: On the team-building day you kept the gaffer dry. He's never mentioned it. You think he wanted to go in.

beats.title: The raft

event.title: The raft
event.speaker: manager
setup: Team building: a lake in the woods, four barrels, some rope, a man in shorts with a whistle. {manager.name} has picked your team to be on, and he's climbing on to your raft, which is leaning.

say: "Right. I'm captain. Paddle when I say paddle." The left barrel is filling with water.

replies.label: Jump off first and save yourself.

tell.text: "It's fine." It isn't. He goes in up to his chest. He comes up laughing, which nobody's seen before. The photo is in his office by Monday.

sank.text: You paddle. You sink. Everyone sinks. The gaffer stands up in four feet of water in his tracksuit and blows the man in shorts's whistle.

jumped.text: You jump to the bank. The raft rights itself without you. The gaffer gets across dry and looks at you on the bank.

beats.hint: The gaffer has a day out planned

beats.title: The woods again

event.title: The woods again
event.speaker: manager
setup: A season on. On the whiteboard in the canteen: TEAM DAY. THE WOODS. BRING A TOWEL. Underneath, someone has drawn a raft sinking.

outcomes.text: "Course you will." You sink again, on purpose, in the first ten metres. He goes under laughing. The man in shorts says he's never seen a team so happy to be wet.
He looks at you. "You jumped last time." You don't, this time. You stay dry anyway.
He's on your raft again. It sinks again. You give him the second towel.
You don't need them. Nobody sinks. It's a bit flat, really.

beats.hint: A season on, the gaffer books the woods
